outcome: requirement for medical devices or equipment
hospitalization in the last year of life
presence of do not resuscitate order
referral to pediatric palliative care team
cohort: Six children diagnosed with Trisomy 18 who were followed in a tertiary pediatric hospital between 1995 and 2020.
finding: The study found that 1-month, 1-year, and 10-year survival rates for children with Trisomy 18 were 66.7%, 33.3%, and 16.7% respectively, highlighting their multiple comorbidities and complex care needs.
followup_time: up to 10 years (based on reported survival outcomes)
